fullContentHtml:
IOCL Apprentice Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) has released the notification for the post of Apprentice. This recruitment has been issued for 325 posts. Online applying process for IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 has started from 05 October 2026 & the candidates can apply till 04 November 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 05 October 2026
  • Last Date : 04 November 2026
  • Merit List Issue : 04 November 2026

Application Fee

  • No Application Fees Any Candidates

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online (NATS)
  • Apply Online (NAPS)
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is IOCL Apprentice Online Form 2026?

IOCL Apprentice Online Form 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
